prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1070; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage limits of every policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page for each. Please also confirm in writing that your company has opened a claim and has taken steps to preserve all evidence relating to the accident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, repair estimates, adjuster notes, telematics, and any dash camera or witness material. Our client's medical treatment and lost income are ongoing, and we will supply documentation as it becomes available. We look forward to your prompt written response.
